title: Chili Con Carne
recipe:
1. Finely chop [the onions](#0) and [garlic](#1). Heat oil in a large pot and brown [the ground beef](#2) with [the paprika](#3), [cumin](#4), [oregano](#5), [garlic powder](#6), and [cinnamon](#7) for 5–6 minutes over medium-high to high heat. Press the meat occasionally to develop browning; uneven browning adds flavor.

2. Clean [the red bell peppers](#8) and cut into roughly 1 cm pieces.

3. Add [the onions](#0) and [peppers](#8) to the pot and cook for 3 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring regularly. Add [the garlic](#1) and cook for 2 minutes more, stirring.

4. Rinse [the black beans](#9) and [kidney beans](#10) in a colander under cold running water and drain well.

5. Add [the canned tomatoes](#11), [chipotle pepper](#12), and [water](#13) to the pot. Crumble [the stock cube](#14) over the top. Mash [the tomatoes](#11) with a wooden spoon. Stir in [the drained beans](#9,10), [chocolate](#15), and [sugar](#16). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper to taste."
imageDescription: Rich, dark chili con carne with visible beans and peppers in a thick sauce, garnished with sour cream, cheddar, and jalapeños
